Using a stone mill, the baker turns whole grains into a fine powder suitable for bread.
After pulping, the machine presses the wet fibers into a flat sheet ready for the next stage.

Above the tray, the cloud contains liquid droplets alongside tiny ice crystals suspended together in the chamber.

Beside the harvest basket, several leafy herbs grow in a dense cluster with flowers and tall grasses.
During the bakery meeting, the manager proposed a cut in the grain budget for the coming month.
